description: Rate one of your bottles 0-5 in steps of 0.25 (0 clears). Posts a 'rated' update like the app. Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only after they agree.

confirm_token.description: Omit on the first call to get a preview. After the user agrees, call again with identical arguments plus this token.

name: rate_bottle
